overviewParagraphs: Grand Phnom Penh Golf Club is one of Cambodia's most genuinely exclusive golf experiences — a private Jack Nicklaus Design facility that restricts access to members and carefully arranged visitor guests, creating an atmosphere of intimacy and privilege that Cambodia's more accessible public courses cannot replicate. The rarity of the access is part of the appeal, and it is a course that AGS clients consistently describe as one of the highlights of their Cambodia golf itinerary.

Nicklaus's characteristic design signature is evident throughout: the bunker complexes are strategically placed to demand precise carry-over or deliberate avoidance decisions on key approach shots, the greens are firm enough to reward approaches from below the pin position, and the routing uses the available land with the spatial efficiency that the Golden Bear's design team is known for globally. It is a demanding, thoughtful course that rewards the patient strategic thinker.

For premium international golf tours that want Cambodia's most exclusive playing experience, AGS's established relationships at Grand Phnom Penh Golf Club provide the access that visiting golfers cannot arrange independently. We recommend pairing it with the Vattanac East Course for a compelling Phnom Penh two-round program that balances public epic scale with private championship intimacy.

curatorBriefHtml: Grand Phnom Penh Golf Club (opened 2009 by Jack Nicklaus Design, roughly 25–30 minutes northwest of central Phnom Penh) is Cambodia’s only Golden Bear signature layout — an exclusive private club set inside a tranquil residential enclave. Playing 6,489 yards from the Blue Tees (Par 72), Nicklaus sculpted classic mounded fairways, glistening white-sand bunkers, and slick undulating greens guarded by strategic water hazards.

Because Grand Phnom Penh operates as a low-traffic private members’ club, visiting groups arranged through AGS enjoy unhurried pace of play and short 25-minute transfers back to Phnom Penh’s riverside dining scene.
Grand Phnom Penh features on The Khmer Kingdom Links, pairing smoothly with Vattanac Golf Resort and Garden City.

scorecard.verdict: The original Jack Nicklaus signature layout in Cambodia. Flawless paspalum turf, subtle doglegs, and deep geometric bunkers reward players who shape their shots with authority.

faqs.q: Can visiting golfers play the private Grand Phnom Penh Golf Club?
faqs.a: Grand Phnom Penh is a private club, and Asia Golf Specialists arranges pre-approved weekday and curated visitor tee times as part of Phnom Penh golf itineraries.

faqs.q: Who designed Grand Phnom Penh Golf Club?
faqs.a: Jack Nicklaus Design — Cambodia’s only Golden Bear course (Par 72, 6,489 yards Blue Tees), showcasing classic Nicklaus bunkering and strategic risk-reward par 5s.

faqs.q: How far is Grand Phnom Penh from central Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Just 25 to 35 minutes northwest of central Phnom Penh by private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Grand Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: November through March delivers dry, sunny mornings and firm parkland conditions.
